lesson.text: Quick memory: what stays private online? (Your name, school, address and photos.) Today: strangers, mean posts, passwords and pop-ups.
A stranger asks for a photo or where you live: don't answer. Block them and tell a grown-up. Online friends you've never met are still strangers.
A mean message: don't reply, keep it to show a grown-up, block, report, and tell. It is never your fault.
This game's password rules: at least 6 letters, never your name, nothing easy to guess like 123456. Never tell anyone your password. Not even a friend.
Pop-ups that want you to download something: close them and ask a grown-up. Free gold for a password is always a trick.
News: who made it, when, and does anyone else say so? If not, don't believe it or share it.
Try it in the world: open Online City on the play tablet. Next: scams, fake news and privacy, on the Big track.

exercises.prompt: A stranger asks where you live. You...
choices: block them and tell a grown-up

exercises.prompt: You should reply to a mean message with something worse.
Your best friend asks for your password. You...
choices: never tell anyone, not even a friend

exercises.prompt: Which password follows this game's rules?
choices: two words and a number only you'd think of
exercises.hint: At least 6, never your name, not easy to guess.
exercises.explain: Two words and a number only you would think of.

exercises.prompt: A mean message: put it in order.
exercises.explain: Keep it, block and report, then tell.

exercises.prompt: An online friend you've never met is still a stranger.
exercises.hint: Do you really know who they are?

exercises.prompt: A pop-up says DOWNLOAD NOW. You...
choices: close it and ask a grown-up
exercises.hint: Never download what a pop-up wants.

exercises.prompt: A message offers free gold for your password. It is...
choices: a trick to take your account
exercises.hint: The real game never asks for it.

exercises.prompt: Check a news story: a good check, or not?
exercises.explain: Who, when, and others: likes prove nothing.

exercises.prompt: An online friend asks to meet at the park: you say no and tell a grown-up.
exercises.hint: Never meet someone you only know online.

exercises.prompt: Someone writes "you're bad at this game". Whose fault is it?
exercises.hint: Unkind words come from the person who writes them.
